english:
Travels along a medium trajectory and calls down a focused strike 0.85 seconds after impact. The strike deals up to <pve 440 /> <pvp [70] /> damage in a 7 meter radius.

A barrage of bolts follows 0.6 seconds after the initial strike, forming an X pattern spanning 7 meters and dealing up to <pve 311 /> <pvp [50] /> damage. <arc Spark of Magnitude /> adds a second barrage in a + pattern spanning 7 meters, dealing the same damage.

Combatants can only be damaged once per barrage. Players can only be damaged by one barrage regardless of pattern.

// The source lists a Combatant damage cap as 751 [1062]. These correspond arithmetically to the listed PvE strikes without and with the extra barrage, but the bracket is not explicitly labeled as a fragment variant. Both values are preserved here without assigning a sandbox or fragment meaning.

source.text:
Medium Trajectory

Calls down a focused strike on impact which hits after 0.85 seconds, dealing up to 440 [70] damage in a 7 meter radius.

After 0.6 seconds of the initial strike:
Calls down a barrage of bolts in a X pattern over 7 meters, dealing up to 311 [50] damage.
Spark of Magnitude: Calls down a second barrage of bolts in an + pattern over 7 meters, dealing up to 311 [50] damage.
Combatants can only be damaged once per barrage, up to a maximum of 751 [1062] damage.
Guardians can only be hurt once by the barrage of bolts, regardless of pattern, for a maximum of 120 damage.
Base Cooldown: 175.6 seconds

Chunk Scalar: 0.625x
